title: Living Cosmos
tagline: Build a planet, shape its climate and food web, and grow a sustainable settlement.
stateNote: An educational game prototype that runs in the browser. Saves stay on your device.
problem: Climate, ecosystems and settlement are usually taught separately. Here one planet connects them, so a change to starlight shows up in the food web.
contribution: It is my project, built with Three.js. The source is private.
worksToday: Place planets, stars, neutron stars and black holes, then enter a planet.
Change climate, run predict-then-observe experiments, and build an outpost, per the README.
Save and load in the browser.
limitations: It uses simplified science and is not a research tool, per the README.

involve.headline: Teach science?
asks: Tell me whether this would work in a classroom.
